scope.definition_of_100_percent: All ECF1.3 implementation invariants ECF13-001..ECF13-030 pass on the exact PR head. Future-supply entries are required as typed interfaces and test fixtures, not as activated product capabilities.

thesis: Expose state, evidence and governed effects; never expose private chain-of-thought. Preserve the current runtime and replace only the critical-path projection and human shell where evidence shows debt.

public_cognitive_path.source: semantic slice, retrieval and temporal context
CRC, grounding, conflicts, horizon and calibration
bounded local generation contract and model/fallback
validated reply persisted as zero-evidence response memory

model_reticulum_feedback.reticulum_to_model: The deterministic cognitive runtime selects/downgrades content, preserves conflicts, sets caution and material-action gates, then compiles a bounded generation contract. The local LLM is a replaceable zero-authority text generator under that contract.
model_reticulum_feedback.model_to_reticulum: Only a validated emitted reply is ingested as RESPONSE/MEMORY with evidence=0.0 and runtime_derived provenance. It may affect later retrieval, activation and temporal continuity, but never becomes external evidence, permission or authority.
forbidden: raw model reasoning as product evidence
model text upgrading its own evidence score
using public cognitive-stage copy to imply consciousness

critical_path.formula: T_visible_reply = T_intake + T_cognitive + T_generation + T_validation + T_frame + T_transport
critical_path.performance_policy: Never claim a speedup from model-server timing alone. Phase-2 must record reproducible end-to-end spans on baseline and candidate. Artifact generation must have zero membership in the pre-primary critical path.

public_ui_grammar: STATE -> TASK? -> CTA? -> CONVERSATION -> COMPOSER -> DETAILS?

invariants.rule: Structured primary text is the live conversation source; ASCII/dashboard parsing is compatibility-only.
The current exact-ACK single-writer transport remains authoritative and unchanged in semantics.
ExperienceProjection is derivative, bounded, cycle/session-bound and has epistemic_authority=0 and execution_authority=0.
CognitiveTraceProjection is derived only from deterministic persisted runtime state/events; it contains no private chain-of-thought or hidden model rationale.
The normal UI exposes only public cognitive stage labels; internal ring/taxonomy names require explicit expert Trace disclosure.
The local LLM remains replaceable, tool-less and zero-authority; generation metrics never become evidence.
Validated model output re-enters the reticulum only as runtime_derived RESPONSE memory with evidence=0.0.
Response memory may modulate future retrieval/activation but can never self-corroborate or upgrade to external evidence.
Every turn has causal phase timing that distinguishes cognitive, generation, validation, frame and transport time.
DOCX generation is outside the pre-primary conversational critical path; JSON cognitive snapshot remains synchronous and cycle-bound.
No duplicate DOCX export occurs for one cycle/version of a snapshot.
An artifact control is visible only if the runtime can fulfill it now; unavailable future features are absent, not disabled placeholders.
Idle ACTIVE chrome contains no hero claim, marketing copy, internal protocol label or persistent helper paragraph.
Runtime state is represented by one concise state location; liveness prose does not create a parallel narrative channel.
A CTA is emitted from server-projected actionable state and is bound to projection/session/cycle identity; UI placement never grants authority.
Material actions surface target, account/provider, scope, cost/irreversibility and approval state before commit.
Pairing, acceptance, verification and start retain existing admission semantics while public labels are concise and non-jargon.
Voice remains transcript-only until explicit Send and output remains post-ACK local-service TTS.
Browser liveness diagnostics remain bounded/redacted and live under Details; they do not clutter the normal composer.
The browser frontend does not duplicate authoritative runtime state; reload/recovery is derived from server state and exact shell binding.
The Phase-2 frontend has one controller ownership path; legacy app.js/conversation.js global override duplication is removed or isolated behind one compatibility adapter.
Service-worker cache upgrades cannot preserve obsolete UI/controller assets across the ECF1.3 release boundary.
Keyboard, focus order, screen-reader labels and reduced-motion semantics are parity features, not optional polish.
The dynamic entity/avatar can reflect only attested runtime stage/state; no mood, confidence or completion is invented by animation.
Future Chrome companion treats content-script/page data as untrusted; privileged operations stay in service worker/native host and use exact capability schemas.
Future native messaging uses exact extension allowed_origins, bounded typed messages and no raw credential transport.
Future OS capture/control uses platform-mediated permission surfaces and semantic APIs before pixel/input fallbacks.
Future floating shell is a zero-authority projection of the same local runtime and never owns cognition, grants, scheduler or receipts.
Updates and component supply are pinned/signed/verified and cannot silently widen runtime capabilities.
ECF1.3 is complete only when source-bound tests, real browser E2E, accessibility checks, baseline-vs-candidate phase timings and the registered mutation harness pass on the exact PR head.

include: remove DOCX from pre-primary critical path and prevent duplicate export
compact current web shell using existing endpoints/transport
public label normalization and taxonomy hiding
runtime-backed Details/Trace and current artifact path
tests, E2E, accessibility, cache upgrade, falsification evidence
